content.short: Pallet Exchange is the leading NFT marketplace on Sei, optimized for high-speed trading and low gas fees.
content.description:
Pallet Exchange is the definitive decentralized NFT marketplace built natively for the Sei Network, designed to provide collectors and artists with a professional-grade environment for digital asset trading. Optimized for Sei's high-speed "Twin-Turbo" consensus, the platform offers sub-second finality and near-zero transaction costs. Pallet serves as the primary liquidity hub for major Sei collections, including Seiyans and Colony, providing a seamless and highly responsive user experience.

Featuring advanced marketplace tools such as real-time floor tracking and instant sweep functionality, Pallet Exchange is built for both retail participants and high-frequency traders. The protocol focuses on user sovereignty and transparent on-chain execution, making it a cornerstone of the Sei creator economy. Through its commitment to high performance and ecosystem-wide collaboration, Pallet Exchange is empowering the next generation of builders and collectors to explore the vast potential of decentralized ownership on Sei.
